title: Coefficient4 log^9 loglog^5 family with tight source budget

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"Fixed total family.py;N<128 or failed guards output0. Let L=ceil(log2 N),z=ceil(log2 L),D=max(2,z),C=2^30; Gamma code of S>0 has H=2floor(log2S)+1 bits;malformed/S>2^L rejects. With P2 rounding:h=P2(SL^2),e=P2(SL^2z),ell=P2(S^3L^2z^2),eprime=P2(S^5L^4z^2),d=P2(S^9L^4z^5),Y=P2(S^11L^7z^5),k=2hY. Initial A1D11,precisionceil(L/28)+10,adaptiveB1,exact reconstructionfield,seedcap5L. Four internal B2.1maps have dimensionD,K=C*e*z^2*M,at most2 eventual calls,stipulated seedell;q0=(4h+C*e*z^2+10)ell. C6 raises all four A1 field degrees to their maximum s_star,rechecks advice/seed predicates,and uses ONE paid C5 package of t_star-a(t_star)bits,t_star=D*s_star,a(t)=floor(log2(floor(log2t)-1)) for t>=32,elsemin(2,t). C5 small-factor CRT decoding and C3 subfield/companion compilation occur once. Each map keeps its own nprime,H,m0,error/calls;bad data yieldzero/ring maps. Good primitive data work universally. Short E1 is direct B2.3,no data. Initial and B5data are canonical by C1 bounded exhaustive search,using initials0<=5L/12 and B5s2<=2048w. B5 uses A2 two1024-wise position samplers,ell_s=P2(r)//2176000,kappa=ell_s//16000,weak outputkappa//8,internal seedD1=5*(1000w)^2+2000w,directA1D4 helper outputP2(D1),errorlog160w+10,and constant-bounded fresh-seed rounds. Prefixdegree1000w/output250w gives shifted agreement. CompleteG is nonlinear; only strong general extraction/shifted agreement are used. Layoutdelta1/125,m=floor(r/125),b=floor(floor(sqrt(S))*w/(30*125^2)),u=2b+2w+10,w=ceil(log2 r). All headers/data are handled by one polynomial-time program. One fixed goodS0 is only a paid restriction. Eventuald0<4L,P=O_S0(L^2z^2)=o(k),initialbad2N^(-1/28) and S_groups^delta<=2^((4/125)L) close the all-length bound. Each biased group uses firstu bits of ONE completed row,ell>=u;capacityB*M<=2^d0. B6 needsO(r^2) goodROW independence and O(r^2u) errorlog,paid separately byh,e.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This fixed total language is in P and NP with empty witnesses on every input. There exist absolute B>0,N0 such that for every actual integer N>=N0, unconditionally in pinned full B2, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^9*(log2(log2 N))^5. For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^9*(log2(log2 N))^(5+epsilon), hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(9+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. One fixed gamma header S0 gives hardness. Exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data; P=O_S0(L^2*(ceil(log2 L))^2)=o(k), including the shared growing-dimension package serving all four maps. The supplied finite4n-8d theorem covers all16 B2 tables, constants and sharing. The robust moment proof needs O(r^2) ROW independence and O(r^2*u) log-error. Layout loses only a factor2^O_S0(log r), preserving actual bad-coordinate accounting. No numerical B, efficient search for S0 or unpaid weak-design construction is assumed. At common admitted scalar plans let s_i be the individual pre-common field degrees,b_i=D_int*s_i-a(D_int*s_i),s_star=max_i s_i,P_individual=H(S)+sum_i b_i. Current P=H(S)+D_int*s_star-a(D_int*s_star),so the certified4*P_individual+8*k loss decreases by4*sum_(i!=j)b_i for any maximum-degree indexj. The full advice/seed predicates are rechecked after enlargement. At the fixed good header P/P_individual tends to1/4. The9,5 asymptotic projection is unchanged. C7 gives P_gamma=H(S0)+shared_data with fixed H(S0); versus the preceding L-bit header at identical scalar plans,the certified loss decreases by4*(L-H(S0)) eventually. Malformed codes output0; all actual header bits are paid. C8 sets k=2hY with preallocation log cap;at common admitted N,S>8 its unchanged P gives exact loss saving8*(P2(S^13L^9z^5)-k),and k/P2(S^13L^9z^5)<=8/S. Initial seed/layout may change;all eventual guards are reproved.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

experiments.purpose: Exact tightened entropy-budget residuals,rounding/comparator and preallocation scalars plus retained gamma-header,shared-field,codec,whole-row,canonical and tower finite predicates. No finite check executes the eventual complete family or proves the universal theorem.
